title: Editorial structure on the shared layout
description:
Six sections, home and about pages and nav subtitles as data (projection.json plus pages), ordered by the one rule (rolling seven-day buckets, quality, recency; sections placed by best item).
Scenario: The home page follows the shared ordering
  Given sections with items of different ages and quality
  When the home page builds
  Then sections and items follow the one ordering rule

Depends on: PPY-196189, PPY-2d9715.
